sv.title: Norwegian hackat – ber kunder spärra betalkort
sv.summary: Omkring 5 000 kunder till Norwegian, däribland i Sverige, har ombetts att spärra sina bankkort.

en.title: Norwegian hacked – urges customers to block payment cards
en.summary: About 5,000 customers of Norwegian, including in Sweden, have been asked to block their bank cards.
